method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: The AI trade is splintering as inflation fears rattle hyped-up tech stocks
Equities.reason: Headline encapsulates the dominant equity narrative: the AI-led rally is fracturing as inflation/rate concerns weigh on richly valued tech names. High relevance because it signals a regime shift in the market leadership and risk appetite.

Equities.title: Stocks Tumble as Concerns Over Inflation and A.I. Investments Grow
Equities.reason: Broad-market summary tying together inflation and AI-investment worries driving risk-off. Relevant to equity risk sentiment and the macro drivers behind the selloff.

Equities.title: Inflation Runs Hot, Stocks Go Cold
Equities.reason: Frames inflation as the key macro impulse denting equities — supports a higher-for-longer rates narrative that is negative for multiple equity sectors and valuation multiples.

Equities.title: Global AI sell-off deepens as Asian markets tumble
Equities.summary: Sharp falls trigger trading halt on South Korea’s Kospi and Japan’s Nikkei 225 sinks 5%, following Wall Street lower
Equities.reason: Demonstrates the global, cross-market nature of the selloff concentrated in AI/chip names and its contagion into Asian markets — high relevance to the overall equity regime and risk-off flows.

Equities.title: SK Hynix shares plunge 10% amid Asia tech rout as Fed rate hike fears, AI funding worries mount
Equities.summary: A sell-off in global technology hardware stocks deepened Thursday.
Equities.reason: Representative of the chip/hardware segment getting hit; useful sector-level signal for global tech-led equity weakness (Asia focus). Single-stock move but indicative of broader chip cycle stress.

Equities.title: Traders pile into 'bubble puts' on CoreWeave as neocloud stocks plunge
Equities.summary: As a key corner of the artificial intelligence trade takes a beating on Wednesday, traders are betting it could get even worse.
Equities.reason: Options-market positioning (puts) shows investor conviction that the AI/neocloud weakness may continue — reinforces negative flow dynamics and sentiment for the equity narrative.

Equities.title: Dell stock plunges 11%, leading data center sell-off as fears mount about 'enterprise AI timing'
Equities.summary: Barclays downgraded Dell, HPE, and NetApp on concerns that enterprise AI adoption is lagging.
Equities.reason: Sector-level hit to data-center/enterprise AI hardware vendors underscores a re-pricing of AI adoption timelines — increases downside risk across tech and related indices.

Equities.title: Treasuries Extend Gains as Equities Selloff Dents Risk Sentiment
Equities.reason: Links the equity weakness to safe-haven moves into Treasuries — supports a rates-led explanation for equity risk-off (higher real yields / flight-to-quality), increasing the macro relevance of the selloff.

Equities.title: TSMC posts record profit for a sixth straight quarter, beating estimates on AI boom
Equities.summary: TSMC reported its third-quarter earnings on Thursday.
Equities.reason: Positive earnings/earnings-beat signal from a bellwether chip supplier supporting the AI demand narrative — acts as a counter-signal to the selloff but lower relevance versus broad risk-off themes.

Equities.title: Anthropic tells investors its quarterly revenue jumped 50%
Equities.summary: Rapid growth is slower than some anticipated as fears about AI trade rattle markets
Equities.reason: Company-level revenue growth confirms underlying demand for AI products but the note that growth is slower than some expectations tempers the positive read — modestly supportive for AI earnings but limited market-moving relevance.

Rates.title: Treasury yields spike as inflation data fuels Fed rate hike fears
Rates.reason: Direct report that Treasury yields spiked after hotter inflation data; clear negative for bond prices and increases odds of further Fed tightening.

Rates.title: Rising bond yields and higher inflation leave the Fed trapped in a rate-hike dilemma
Rates.reason: Macro narrative tying higher yields and sticky inflation to a more hawkish Fed path — meaningful market-wide implication for rates (negative for bonds).

Rates.title: Top Forecaster Says Fed May Hike Rates Half a Point in December
Rates.reason: Explicit market-forecaster view that a larger Fed hike is possible lifts terminal-rate expectations — negative for bond prices / pushes yields higher.

Rates.title: Red hot CPI report fuels AI rout
Rates.reason: Reuters links a hot CPI print to market sell-off and rate-hike worries — direct negative impulse for bonds via higher yields.

Rates.title: Inflation Jolt Raises Stakes for Warsh’s Final Word in Bangkok
Rates.reason: Story highlights how renewed inflation pressure elevates Fed officials' comments and complicates policy messaging — bearish for bonds.

Rates.title: Stock Market News, October 14, 2026: Treasury Yields Turn Lower as Stocks Slump
Rates.reason: WSJ notes a later intra-day move where yields retraced lower as equities fell — a smaller, short-term bond-friendly counter-move to the dominant hawkish CPI reaction.

Rates.title: China seems routing US Treasury holdings through Canada – Bloomberg
Rates.summary: According to a Bloomberg report, China seems to be moving United States (US) securities to non-US custodian banks in other countries, masking its role in financing US deficits.
Rates.reason: Potential masking of China’s Treasury holdings raises transparency and demand concerns — could be negative for Treasuries if it signals covert selling or weaker visible demand.

Rates.title: China’s Backdoor Bond-Buying Talk Swirls on $600 Billion Buildup
Rates.reason: Talk of large-scale 'backdoor' bond-buying would be supportive for global bond markets — a meaningful countervailing force to rate-hike-driven selloffs.

Rates.title: Bonds Pay the Price for India’s Rupee Defense as Rate Bets Build
Rates.reason: Local bond selling tied to FX defense and broader rate-bet repricing — negative for domestic bonds and part of the wider global pressure on yields.

Rates.title: CoreWeave sparks worry about broader credit-market stress as its bonds tumble
Rates.reason: Concerns about a corporate bond blowup (AI-related leverage) increase credit spreads and add downside pressure to risk-sensitive fixed-income sectors.

Rates.title: Fannie Mae sharply raises mortgage rate forecast for 2027
Rates.summary: Fannie Mae just put out its latest forecast for mortgage rates, and they are much higher than previous estimates.
Rates.reason: Upward revisions to mortgage-rate forecasts reflect higher term-rate expectations — negative for bond prices and indicative of enduring higher-for-longer real rates.

Rates.title: BoE’s Pill says should not give impression that hike now would be the start of a series of increases
Rates.summary: Bank of England (BoE) Chief Economist Huw Pill, who has voted for a quarter-point interest rate hike in recent months, said on Thursday that we should not give impression that a hike now would be the start of a series of increases.
Rates.reason: BoE rhetoric aimed at avoiding signaling a sustained tightening cycle can temper gilt yields — a modest supportive signal for bonds relative to stronger hawkish reads elsewhere.

FX.title: ECB’s Pereira: The good news is that inflation is not spreading
FX.summary: European Central Bank policymaker and newly appointed Portugal central bank governor Alvaro Santos Pereira made some comments on inflation, yields, and energy prices during his speech on Thursday.
FX.reason: ECB official signals inflation is not broadening — reduces the case for additional ECB tightening. That is a EUR-negative (EURUSD downside / USD relative support) macro narrative for FX markets; central-bank speak is moderately market-relevant.

FX.title: ECB’s Dolenc says central bank may not have to do as much if markets tighten
FX.summary: European Central Bank (ECB) Governing Council member Primoz Dolenc said on Wednesday that a tightening in financial conditions may limit the need for central bank monetary policy action.
FX.reason: Explicit suggestion that market tightening could substitute for policy tightening weakens the ECB hiking narrative — negative for EUR vs USD. High relevance because it alters rate-expectation transmission to FX markets.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar holds gains as US Dollar declines despite increasing Fed rate hike bets
FX.summary: USD/CAD depreciates after registering gains in the previous day, trading around 1.4200 during Asian hours on Thursday.
FX.reason: USD/CAD moves lower (CAD strength) despite higher Fed-hike probabilities — signals CAD resilience and short-term USD softness. Direct USD/CAD flow is FX-native and relevant to USD/dollar-basket dynamics.

FX.title: British Pound sticks to gains vs USD as BoE Pill's dovish tone cap upside ahead of UK data
FX.summary: The GBP/USD pair is seen building on the overnight bounce from the 1.3135 area, or the year-to-date low, and gaining strong follow-through positive traction during the Asian session on Thursday.
FX.reason: GBP/USD is firming but BoE dovish signalling limits upside — net modest GBP strength vs USD in the short term. Relevant as a USD-centric major-pair move influenced by central-bank commentary.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar jumps to two-week top vs weak USD as RBNZ's Conway hints rate hikes
FX.summary: The NZD/USD pair gains strong positive traction during the Asian session on Thursday, building on the previous day's late rebound from the 0.5565 region, or its lowest level since April 2025.
FX.reason: RBNZ official hinting at hikes lifts NZD vs USD — a clear USD-pair move driven by central-bank signals. High relevance because it changes near-term rate-differential expectations and USD-basket composition.

FX.title: BoJ's Koeda urges timely rate adjustments based on economic and price conditions
FX.summary: Bank of Japan Board Member Junko Koeda said on Thursday that attention focused on price upside risks from Japanese Yen (JPY) depreciation, robust global AI demand, and the Middle East situation impact.
FX.reason: BoJ board member flags price risks from JPY depreciation and calls for timely adjustments — markets may price a less dovish BoJ or intervention/backstop, which is JPY-positive vs USD. High relevance given BoJ comments’ outsized FX impact.

FX.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Strengthens above 177.00, but bearish bias persists below key resistance
FX.summary: The EUR/JPY cross trades in positive territory near 177.10 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. However, the potential upside for the cross might be limited as traders remain on high alert for currency intervention from Japanese authorities.
FX.reason: EUR/JPY strength is being monitored alongside explicit intervention risk from Japanese authorities — the intervention narrative is FX-native and implies potential JPY support/intervention that can reverberate across USD/JPY and broader FX markets.

Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) struggles to capitalize on its strong Asian session move up on Thursday and currently trades below $4,150. The commodity, however, retains an intraday bullish bias, snapping a three-day losing streak to a one-week low, touched on Wednesday, amid
Commodities.reason: Near-term bullish bias for gold but upside capped by Fed-hike expectations and yield/USDbeta mentioned in headline — positive for gold but partially offset by policy; medium relevance to precious-metals narrative.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD rebounds to near $56.00 as oil prices, US Dollar decline
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) gains ground after three days of losses, trading around $56.00 per troy ounce during Asian hours on Thursday. Non-yielding Silver gained ground as crude oil prices declined and pressure across other markets eased.
Commodities.reason: Price-forecast/technical piece showing rebound linked to weaker USD and oil — bullish for silver but format limits relevance (forecast/technical).

Commodities.title: Investors predict new record price for gold within two years
Commodities.summary: Central banks in September made their highest monthly purchases of the precious metal for almost two years
Commodities.reason: Central-bank buying and investor forecasts point to a materially bullish medium-term gold narrative — high relevance as a macro driver for precious metals.

Commodities.title: London’s gold market enjoys the Trump effect
Commodities.summary: The City’s dominance of physical trading in the metal is being reinforced by global instability
Commodities.reason: Physical-market flow and increased London dominance amid geopolitical instability support stronger gold demand — reinforces broader bullish precious-metals narrative.

Commodities.title: IMF says the biggest risk is prolonged conflict
Commodities.summary: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) said on Thursday that a prolonged war in the Middle East and further disruptions to energy production, shipping routes, or critical infrastructure pose the biggest risk to regional and global economies.
Commodities.reason: Explicit callout that prolonged conflict risks energy/transport disruption — positive for oil risk premia and safe-haven metals; broad macro significance raises relevance.

Commodities.title: Oil falls as investors assess Mideast tensions, International Energy Agency's report
Commodities.summary: Oil fell Thursday, as traders assessed attacks on ships passing through Hormuz, while digesting the International Energy Agency's latest monthly report.
Commodities.reason: Near-term price drop after digesting IEA report and shipping attack news — short-term negative for oil prices, medium relevance given market attention to IEA and Gulf developments.

Commodities.reason: Technical/forecast piece indicating bullish bias persists for WTI — positive near-term bias but format limits relevance (technical/forecast capped relevance).

Commodities.title: Oil Holds Gain as Middle East and Russia Strikes Threaten Supply
Commodities.reason: Report highlights active supply threats from Middle East and Russia strikes — reinforces sustained oil risk premium and bullish price regime; high relevance.

Commodities.title: Copper squeeze breathes new life into old mines

Crypto.title: BlackRock's crypto ETF assets surge 63% but remain far below 2025 peak
